objective: Characterize Add Noise's deterministic hash field as grain-like texture: pixel/block scale, spatial-frequency distribution, channel correlation by mode, seed variation, tone-dependent clipping, and resolution response.

scope.effect: Artifact::AddNoiseEffect CPU source equation and the numerically equivalent resident generic shader equation
scope.method: Independent NumPy mirror of the exact uint32 hash and Add Noise mode equations using locally generated opaque synthetic plates.
excluded: dedicated GPU wrapper's known float-bitcast seed variant

comparison.baseline: Opaque synthetic grayscale flat panels at values .02, .10, .50, .90, .98 and amount=0; source baseline is not a film-grain quality target.
comparison.ground_truth: None. The hash equation is the mathematical source authority for this model; no perceptual reference image exists.
comparison.acceptance: Descriptive characterization only; no effect-quality pass/fail threshold or assertion that a control range is aesthetically suitable.

materials.statistics_fixture: Synthetic opaque constant-value panels, each at least 64x64; no source/alpha ambiguity.
materials.visual_fixture: Synthetic chart with shadow/midtone/highlight patches, saturated color patches, fine lines and checker detail.
materials.rights: Generated locally by the study script.
materials.identity: Record SHA-256 for plan, script, imported hash-equation runner, source files, metrics and preview PNGs.

conditions.format: Float32 BGRA storage, logically opaque RGB, direct linear numeric values in [0,1]; no transfer conversion or display transform in metrics.
conditions.alpha: Opaque alpha=1 throughout; alpha-edge evaluation is covered by a separate study.
metrics: per-region RGB mean/std/quantiles, exact 0/1 endpoints, and within-1e-6-of-endpoint fractions
luma intermediate exact clamp fractions in luma-only mode
noise residual mean/variance and channel cross-correlation
2D power spectrum low/high frequency energy and anisotropy
cell-run lengths and unique hash-cell counts
same-seed repeatability and cross-seed residual correlation
conditions.display: Direct clipped RGB8 diagnostics and same-scale contact sheets; raw float statistics are authoritative.

effect_correctness.method: Verify seed uint32 conversion, floor(coord/size), channel salts, uint32 hash overflow, mode precedence, RGB clamp and alpha pass-through against source markers.
effect_correctness.acceptance_criteria: Deterministic outputs and exact hash-field agreement with helper equations; no compiled/runtime parity claim.

image_quality_and_detail.method: Inspect same-scale chart plates and fixed flat/line/checker crops at 1:1 and enlarged view; report block pattern, tonal clipping, chromatic texture and detail visibility.
image_quality_and_detail.acceptance_criteria: No aesthetic pass/fail; do not infer film realism.

color_and_alpha.method: Measure RGB channel response and tone-dependent clipping on opaque bounded values.
color_and_alpha.unverified: HDR/negative input behavior beyond prior route audit, alpha-edge output, transfer/display behavior.

temporal_stability.method: The hash receives x,y,channel,seed and no frame/time input; a stable seed/control therefore repeats the field by equation.
temporal_stability.unverified: Application parameter automation, live output sequence, seek/reverse, rendered temporal perceptual behavior.

render_paths_and_resolution.method: Compare the same parameter values on 512x256 and 1024x512 plates; document pixel-cell scale and exact crop/correspondence behavior.
render_paths_and_resolution.unverified: Actual resolution scaling, LOD, preview/final route and GPU/backend output.

performance.reason: No product timing, GPU memory, or allocation profiling.

execution.backend: Python 3, NumPy, OpenCV, Pillow; local synthetic generation only.
execution.threshold_policy: No perceptual threshold; report descriptive statistics and limitations.
execution.reproducibility: Fixed sizes, amounts, modes and seeds; record library versions, source/runner/plan/script hashes, output hashes and metrics checksum.

amendments.reason: Initial characterization reports within-field correlation and cell run lengths but does not directly tell whether changing Size below one pixel changes spatial frequency or merely selects a new independent hash pattern. Resolution behavior is also explicit in scope and merits a direct coordinate-overlap check.
amendments.change: Add same-seed pairwise field correlation/RMSE between every Size value at matched resolution, emphasizing .5 versus 1.0; add exact equality/RMSE of corresponding top-left noise fields between 512x256 and 1024x512 for each Size, Seed and channel. Rerun all metrics and previews after the amendment.
amendments.scope_effect: This remains a source-equation model. It characterizes pixel-coordinate hashing and control response, not perceptual scaling under app LOD, image resampling, or actual renderer output.

amendments.reason: Initial exact-endpoint clip metrics show zero output RGB channels at exactly 1.0 for the luma-mode .98 highlight panel even though the luma intermediate saturates. Float32 channel reconstruction can leave values just below 1, making exact endpoint counts insufficient to describe near-clipping.
amendments.change: For every tonal region, add channel fractions within 1e-6 of 0 and 1, plus the luma intermediate's exact lower/upper clamp fractions when luma-only mode is selected. Keep exact endpoint counts and rerun all outputs.
amendments.scope_effect: Adds a precision-aware descriptive metric; no thresholds or quality conclusions change.
